stoic.definition:
n. a member of the ancient Greek school of philosophy founded by Zeno
n. someone who is seemingly indifferent to emotions
s. seeming unaffected by pleasure or pain; impassive
stoic.translation:
a. 斯多葛派的, 禁欲主义的, 不以苦乐为意的, 坚忍的, 淡泊的
n. 斯多葛派学者, 画廊派的人, 禁欲主义者, 不介意苦乐的人, 高度自制的人

stoical.definition: s seeming unaffected by pleasure or pain; impassive
stoical.translation: a. 禁欲主义的, 不以苦乐为意的, 坚忍的, 淡泊的

stoically.definition: r. without emotion; in a stoic manner
stoically.translation: adv. 坚忍地；恬淡寡欲地

stoicheiometry.translation: [医] 化学计算学, 化学计量学

stoichiological.definition: a. Of or pertaining to stoichiology.

stoichiology.definition:
n. That part of the science of physiology which treats
   of the elements, or principles, composing animal tissues.
n. The doctrine of the elementary requisites of mere
   thought.
n. The statement or discussion of the first principles
   of any science or art.

stoichiometer.translation: [医] 化学计算器, 化学计量器

stoichiometric.definition: a. of or relating to stoichiometry
stoichiometric.translation: a. 化学计量的；化学计算的

stoichiometric compounds.translation: [化] 定比化合物; 化学计量化合物

stoichiometrical.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to stoichiometry; employed in,
   or obtained by, stoichiometry.

stoichiometries.definition:
plural of stoichiometry
n. (chemistry) the relation between the quantities of substances that take part in a reaction or form a compound (typically a ratio of whole integers)
stoichiometries.translation:
(stoichiometry 的复数) n. 化学计算, 化学计算法, 化学计量学
[化] 化学计量学; 化学计量法

stoichiometry.definition: n. (chemistry) the relation between the quantities of substances that take part in a reaction or form a compound (typically a ratio of whole integers)
stoichiometry.translation:
n. 化学计算, 化学计算法, 化学计量学
[化] 化学计量学; 化学计量法

stoicism.definition:
n. an indifference to pleasure or pain
n. (philosophy) the philosophical system of the Stoics following the teachings of the ancient Greek philosopher Zeno
stoicism.translation: n. 斯多葛哲学, 禁欲主义, 淡泊

stoics.definition:
n. a member of the ancient Greek school of philosophy founded by Zeno
n. someone who is seemingly indifferent to emotions
stoics.translation: n. 禁欲主义者, 恬淡寡欲的人, 不以苦乐为意的人( stoic的复数形式 )
